## Checklist

- [ ] `npm test` passes (and `npm run build` if the frontend changed)
- [ ] `lib/types.ts` regenerated if a model in `backend/app/domain/` changed
- [ ] Documentation updated where [CONTRIBUTING](../CONTRIBUTING.md#keeping-the-documentation-current) says
- [ ] No cloud SDK outside its adapter, no hard-coded paths or origins
